inputs: all 8 historical and 12 fresh bounded contexts from prior cache read-only, 8 decisive fixtures; all 9 old closed-loops for A1-A6 mapping and safety/efficiency retention
A: compare native raw first-step feedback propagation, post-SG/shift SDK reconstruction, returned Twist, smoother target, native applied JointVelocityCmd, plant state and next odometry; frame base_link, pose odom=map only in identity fixture

motion_categories.A6: wait/narrow predicted obstacle active and speed<.08

observer: no publishers, no ECM mutation, native pre-update joint-target snapshot plus physics state at known sim step; not measured actuator force or MCU application
fixed: same original 10Hz/.1/300x30/one iteration, padded footprint .34/.29, .8/.8/2 smoother and +/-2 Gazebo limit; gate goal/no actor contact/dynamic bbox>=.047/no sampled wall bbox, no change

B.build: Release -O3; no fast-math or lower precision
B.coverage: full 301x30 with 11 points/segment, same Lipschitz reserve/unknown handling and geometry; single-selected workload separately labelled
B.profile: instrumented unchanged reference plus plain reference, no optimization before hotspot evidence
B.allocation: global new counts/allocated bytes during call, RSS outside; not total ROS memory
B.scope: time parsing/preparation, coordinate/interpolation/transform, static geometry, dynamic geometry, nominal rates, native comparison, result/serialization separately

optimizations_allowed: only snapshot-lifetime typed immutable values/time interpolation, footprint buffer reuse, exact static occupied/unknown row indexing and skip geometry once exact zero minimum is known; no sampling reduction, no false Safe for Unknown
equality: all categorical flags/counters equal, clearance and nominal acceleration <=1e-12 absolute difference; retain malformed/expired/map-change/footprint-change cases; primary frozen gate unchanged
budget: 10Hz total cycle 100ms, not 100ms extra checker; compare per-case MPPI observed p99 plus checker p99, also maxima. This empirical screening is not a realtime scheduling proof. Single selected pass cannot prove every candidate or final safe action.
stop: do not rewrite optimizer/CV/KF, alter production modules, add motion owner, push/merge or start Cprime; explicit unresolved execution bounds or budget gaps => Modify/Wait
